description:
Introduce the `multi check` subcommand and the top-level orchestration skeleton the rest of the project fills in. Add a `CheckSubcommand` (clap `Args`) under `src/config/check/`, exported from `src/config/mod.rs`, starting with a working-directory arg (default `.`). Land the configuration → discovery → execution → reporting phases as stubs; mirrors the existing `Run` command (`src/cmd/run`, `src/config/run`).

———
